channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Finch | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Finch from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Chris Finch, LaMelo Ball
item.description:
“I never thought I could develop any point guard skills. I know [coach Chris Finch] harps on me passing the ball, but now we got LaMelo, so I'm happy.”

Anthony Edwards on Chris Finch, LaMelo Ball, Sep 28, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Matt Lloyd on Alonzo Gee, Chris Finch, Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards, Jonathan Kuminga
item.description:
Matt Lloyd:

“The opportunity came up to sign Jonathan Kuminga, which again was the product of many, many phone calls and a lot of time investment. My wife asked me at one point, how many times has he called you? She was referencing Jonathan Kuminga's agent. How many times have you been on the phone with him since the middle of July? So I said, okay, I will look, and we went through my phone and we had 94 phone calls between July 15th to the day we signed Jonathan. Anthony Edwards was really instrumental in recruiting him to come here. We had several conversations with him, his representatives, and from Chris Finch to Tim Connelly to Alonzo Gee, who is on our staff, everything just came together.”

Matt Lloyd on Alonzo Gee, Chris Finch, Tim Connelly, Anthony Edwards, Jonathan Kuminga, Sep 19, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Micah Nori on Chris Finch
item.description:
Micah Nori:

“The one thing that coach Finch is, he is very very good at what he does. Number one, there's no paranoia with him and the other thing is he will let you coach and gives you a voice. When those things happen, I was fortunate to be with him for a long time and work with him. Philosophy-wise and the way we think about basketball is very very similar.”

Micah Nori on Chris Finch, Jul 11, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Devin Vassell on Chris Finch
item.description:
Devin Vassell on Chris Finch's claim that Wemby got away with 4, 5 goaltends in Game 1:

“There's always going to be something. They always going to have something to say. I guarantee you Vic's going to keep blocking shots and they're going to have something to say.”

Devin Vassell on Chris Finch, May 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Chris Finch
item.description:
Insightful quote from Anthony Edwards on hisrelationshiop with Chris Finch (1/2):

“As you’re growing up to be a young adult, you always want to think about, ‘Aw, he trying me. I want to say something back. He trying my manhood.' But when you think about it. I would’vebeen a fool in film to say something back. He ain’t trying my manhood, because the clips on there, they look bad.”

Anthony Edwards on Chris Finch, Jan 30, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Mike Conley on Chris Finch
item.description:
Mike Conley on Finch's words:

“Guys were upset in the locker room before he got in there, and then when he left guys were really just quiet. Kind of soaking in all the information we just heard. We’ll respond. This group responds well to that.”

Mike Conley on Chris Finch, Jan 28, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Chris Finch
item.description:
Christopher Hine:Anthony Edwards:

“[Finch has] been coaching his butt off as far as the rotations, the ins and outs of the subs. Finding how to play me and Julius together.”

Anthony Edwards on Chris Finch, Dec 28, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Julius Randle on Chris Finch
item.description:
“His understanding of spacing, actions on and off the ball, sets, all that different type of stuff, what is a good shot and a bad shot. He really simplifies the game. I felt that when I was in New Orleans and I feel that here now. I don’t have to force anything … “What other coach would I love playing for other than Finch? He knows my game so well. Once I started thinking about that side of it, I got really excited.”

Julius Randle on Chris Finch, Oct 29, 2024. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Julius Randle on Tom Thibodeau, Chris Finch
item.description:
said Randle, who averaged 22.6 points on 17.7 shots during his Knicks career.

“That’s what I genuinely like to do. That’s how I grew up playing basketball. The situation here in New York, [Tom Thibodeau] needed me to score more, and I took on that responsibility. And Jalen came along, and he took a little bit off of me, as well. But I enjoy playmaking. That’s what I enjoy doing. “And [Minnesota coach Chris Finch] is putting me in many different positions to play-make. And I’m excited to be able to show that. Not just from the post, getting double-teamed. Finch is moving me all over the floor, allowing me to be able show that stuff. I’m excited about that.”

Julius Randle on Tom Thibodeau, Chris Finch, Oct 13, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Chris Finch
item.description:
“I remember when [Chris] Finch got hurt, Ant said, ‘If this is what getting old look like, I don’t wanna get old.’I was like, Ant, ‘He got his knee ran into’. He's like, ‘I don’t care.’”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Chris Finch, Aug 22, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Chris Finch
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Anthony Edwards on Timberwolves coach Chris Finch:

“He's just a great coach, and he don't sugarcoat anything with anybody. If KAT's f****** up he's gonna get on KAT. If I'm f****** up, he's gonna get on me. If Rudy f****** up, he’s gonna get on anybody messing up throughout the game. Ithink that’s what makes him the best coach in the NBA to me because no matter who it is or how high the player is on the pole, he’s going to get on you from start to finish. It starts with the head of the snake, and he’s the head of our snake. We all listen to him, look up to him, and he does a great job of making sure we’re ready to go every night.”

Anthony Edwards on Chris Finch, May 20, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Micah Nori on Chris Finch
item.description:
Micah Nori on Chris Finch being at practice today, a day after surgery and in a leg brace with crutches:

“I'll tell you, he’s a trooper and he’s a warrior. But it’s always good, anytime you have your leader in the building, able to conduct practices, conduct film rooms, conduct meetings. The more that we can stay closer to the norm and just the rhythm that we’ve had all year, it’s great.”

Micah Nori on Chris Finch, May 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Chris Finch
item.description:
“The whole staff is really connected. I think Finch empowers those guys. So it's a collective, it's not just about one person. We have next man up with players and it's the same with coaches.”

Tim Connelly on Chris Finch, May 2, 2024. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Anthony Edwards on Chris Finch
item.description:
Anthony Edwards on Finch and staff coaching All-Star game:

“That probably was the greatest thing of this season. That’s dope for him to get recognized for how great he’s coached this year.”

Anthony Edwards on Chris Finch, Feb 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Chris Finch
item.description:
He converted both free throws with 3.6 seconds left to send Minnesota to a 125-124 win against the Hawks on Wednesday night.

“Shoutout to Finch having that confidence in me after 51 games and all of the things I had to deal with,”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Chris Finch, Mar 24, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Glen Taylor on Chris Finch
item.description:
The input of head coach Chris Finch, who expressed confidence in his ability to use Gobert and Karl-Anthony Towns, was also a key factor in Minnesota’s decision to pull the trigger on the blockbuster deal.

“What I did when Tim and Chris talked to me about this trade is to ask (Finch) is there a system that he knows how to utilize these players,”

Glen Taylor on Chris Finch, Aug 11, 2022. Source: Hoops Rumors.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Chris Finch
item.description:
“Finch got into it. I like it, I like it. Finch is coaching, man. He’s a hell of a coach, man,”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Chris Finch, Mar 13, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Chris Finch
item.description:
“I have a coach [Chris Finch] that trusts me, a coach that trusts me with the ball,”

Patrick Beverley on Chris Finch, Jan 4, 2022. Source: Minneapolis Star-Tribune.

item.title: Michael Malone on Chris Finch
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on former assistant Chris Finch:

“He’s got a great feel for the game. A great mind. Very smart. I talked about trying to bring him back even after that initial time he was with us. I think he’s a hell of a coach.”

Michael Malone on Chris Finch, Oct 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Chris Finch
item.description:
Christopher Hine:Patrick Beverley on Chris Finch:

“That’s my guy. I don’t have a lot of guys, so if I say he’s my guy, it means a lot.”

Patrick Beverley on Chris Finch, Oct 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Chris Finch
item.description:
Alvin Gentry on one important factor in a no-fan environment:

“(Assistant coach) Chris Finch said your bench is going to be really important, from an enthusiasm standpoint. I think that’s where all of the energy is going to come from. You’re going to need a really good bench.”

Alvin Gentry on Chris Finch, Jun 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.
